Exclude prefixes matching any official train action prefix or development input. Native base and candidate scored on identical label-free inputs; labels stay local.
development: Exactly the frozen500 abcd-001 inputs/labels; no new calibration or prompt edits
evaluation: Reload serialized BF16 adapter; native batch1/no-graphs readout; all30 options, published temperatures1.22 and0.93
final_success: At least5 percentage point accuracy gain over base; paired95% bootstrap accuracy-gain and Brier-improvement intervals both strictly above0; macroF1 does not regress. Report frozen frequency baselines and all failures.
inputs: Identical full conversation-prefix and compact workflow representation to abcd-001
limitations: Development selection is exploratory; recorded action agreement is not full policy compliance or conversation success. Public pretraining overlap cannot be excluded.
limits: One recipe,1024 train examples;75min training/dev budget;80min hard service cap; separate20min cap for conditional final inference
promotion: Research only; no live model, registry, or website changes
question: Can a small domain adapter beat unchanged JevK5 on recorded ABCD next-action prediction?

recipe.initialization: unchanged JevK5 v0.3; fresh attention-only LoRA
recipe.loss: Cross entropy on native BF16 option logits divided by1.22, label smoothing0.05

selection: Highest accuracy among qualifying checkpoints, then lowerBrier, then earlier checkpoint; retain base if none qualify
step_zero_check: First8 unchanged dev probability vectors must match within1e-6 before training

timing_amendment.reason: Measured20.07seconds for8 training cases implies~43minutes training plus three500-case dev evaluations; original60minute cap risks truncating final checkpoint

training: 1024 distinct official train conversations, one hash-selected action each, seed553, one shuffled epoch
training_views: Half gold-containing native15-option group; half gold plus15 random negative actions in shuffled order. One view per conversation, frozen before training. Native evaluation always offers all30 actions.
